metadata.pr_title: fix: add cache headers for images
metadata.pr_description:
# Overview

Fixes https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues/4438

Majority of discussion was in:
1. https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues/4438
2. https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/pull/5174 and 

TL;DR: Add cache controls to store images for 1 day and only try to resolve missing images every 1 hour.

## Problem
1. [model_manager.py](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/blob/5352abc6d389570455776c457738db54367cd6cb/app/model_manager.py#L52-L77) has an experimental preview endpoint to serve preview images from the filesystem.
2. [frontend code](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/blob/8646ca416210acd12618d31bffe4cb042b1c6607/src/components/sidebar/tabs/modelLibrary/ModelTreeLeaf.vue#L46-L56) tries to fetch images these images, but there is no cache control on them so we repeatedly fetch and download them.
3. This causes unnecessary traffic to the server and a lot of network traffic noise in development.
4. We fix this by adding caching logic for images in our middleware.

## Review Points
1. Are we okay with the default `max-age` values? One day for images and permanent redirects. One hour for image 404's.

The new middleware sets cache headers based on file types and response statuses.
